title: AkoVoice Rubric Schema
description:
Open schema for voice-based competency assessment rubrics supporting Socratic, Observer, and Moderator modes across any national qualification framework. Released under CC BY 4.0. Rubric content authored using this schema may carry separate licensing terms specified in rubric metadata.

Text encoding: All string values must be valid UTF-8 and support the full Unicode range including CJK, right-to-left scripts, and combining diacritics. Implementations should normalise text to Unicode NFC (Canonical Composition) before storage, comparison, and transmission. Identifier fields (rubric_id, criterion_id) are restricted to URL-safe ASCII to ensure portability in URIs, API paths, and file systems.

schema_version.description: The AkoVoice schema version this rubric conforms to. Uses two-part versioning (major.minor) tracking the AkoVoice schema release — distinct from the rubric content version field which uses three-part semver. Implementations should reject rubrics with schema versions they do not support.
schema_version.$comment: Two-part versioning is intentional: schema_version tracks AkoVoice schema releases (0.1, 1.0), version tracks rubric content revisions (1.0.0, 1.2.3). Keep these distinct.

rubric_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this rubric. Must be URL-safe to support use in URIs and API paths. Recommended formats: reverse-domain notation, URN, or UUID. Should not change across revisions; use version field for revisions.

version.description: Semantic version of this rubric's content. Increment when descriptors, criteria, or judgement change.

description.description: Description of what this rubric assesses and its intended use context.

language.description: Primary language of dialogue, expressed as a BCP 47 language tag. The agent will conduct the session in this language. Use the 'translations' field for multilingual rubrics. Text content in all fields must be valid UTF-8. Implementations should normalise Unicode text to NFC (Canonical Composition) before storage and comparison.

translations.description: Translations of user-facing strings into additional languages. Keys are BCP 47 tags. Values mirror the structure of translatable fields. Optional.

mode.description: The assessment interaction mode. Socratic: agent conducts 1-to-1 dialogue with learner. Observer: agent silently observes dialogue between humans. Moderator: agent participates as third voice facilitating multi-party assessment.

sub_mode.description: Applicable when mode is 'socratic'. Formative coaches understanding without final judgement. Summative produces provisional judgement for assessor sign-off.

judgement_scheme.description: Declares the assessment judgement model this rubric uses. Frameworks differ globally; rubrics declare their own scheme rather than the schema imposing one.

type.description: binary: competent/not_yet. three_level: e.g. pass/merit/distinction. four_level: e.g. NZ achieved/merit/excellence with not_yet. points: numeric scoring. custom: arbitrary level set defined in levels array.

levels.description: Ordered list of level identifiers used in this rubric, from lowest to highest. For binary: ["not_yet_competent", "competent"]. For three_level: ["not_yet", "pass", "merit"] or equivalent. For points: may be empty — scoring is numeric. For all other types at least one level is required.

level_labels.description: Human-readable labels for each level, keyed by level identifier. Shown in reports and interfaces.

pass_threshold.description: The minimum level that constitutes a passing judgement for this rubric. Must match one of the level identifiers.

points_range.description: For points-based schemes, the numeric range.

holistic_judgement_required.description: Whether the rubric requires a single overall judgement in addition to per-criterion judgements.

global_descriptors.description: Rubric-level descriptors describing overall performance at each judgement level. Used for holistic judgement and summary reporting. Keys are level identifiers declared in judgement_scheme.levels.

jurisdiction.description: The legal, cultural, or regulatory context in which this assessment operates. Deliberately neutral — does not imply or deny sovereign status of any entity. Use 'economy' for any entity with its own qualification or legal framework, regardless of political status.

type.description: economy: any entity with its own legal/qualification framework (covers nation-states, territories, special administrative regions, and entities without political commitment). indigenous_region: First Nations, tribal territories with distinct legal/cultural authority. supranational: multi-economy regulatory bodies (EU, ASEAN, African Union, CARICOM, Pacific Community). custom: any other context with notes.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code where applicable. For entities without ISO codes use a widely recognised alternative or leave blank and use name.

notes.description: Any relevant context about the jurisdiction's legal status, applicable legislation, or special requirements implementers should be aware of.

regulatory_body.description: The body that certifies, endorses, or quality-assures qualifications assessed using this rubric. Distinct from jurisdiction — a regulatory body may operate nationally, sectorally, or internationally across multiple jurisdictions.

name.description: Name of the regulatory or awarding body.

code.description: Commonly used abbreviation or code for the body.

scope.description: national: operates within one economy. sectoral: covers a specific industry across economies (e.g. IMO for maritime, ICAO for aviation). international: cross-economy general authority (e.g. ILO, WorldSkills International). custom: other.

occupational_classification.description: Occupational classification references for the trade or skill this rubric assesses. Distinct from qualification framework alignment — classifies the occupation, not the credential. Use ISCO-08 as the globally portable reference; add regional classifications as needed.

isco_08.description: ILO International Standard Classification of Occupations 2008 code. Globally portable and used by UNESCO, ILO, ADB, and World Bank.

anzsco.description: Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations code.

esco.description: European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations classification URI.

tvetipedia_terms.description: UNESCO-UNEVOC TVETipedia glossary terms describing the occupational domain of this rubric. Provides internationally recognised vocabulary for the trade or skill area. See unevoc.unesco.org/home/TVETipedia+Glossary.

custom.description: Any additional occupational classification references not covered above.

framework_alignment.description: References to external qualification frameworks and standards this rubric aligns with. All fields optional but strongly encouraged for portability and interoperability.

national_framework.description: Name of the national qualification framework.

unit_standard_code.description: Reference code in the national framework.

custom_alignments.description: Any additional framework alignments. Keys are framework names, values are references.

agent_configuration.description: Configuration for how the voice agent presents itself in dialogue. All fields optional with sensible defaults.

register.description: Communication register. Implementations may add to this list.

cultural_framing.description: Cultural context notes for the agent. For example, appropriate greetings, pacing, terms of address, and cultural sensitivities for the learner population.

opening_statement.description: The agent's opening statement. Should introduce the assessment context and (where required) confirm consent. If omitted, a default opening is generated from rubric metadata.

closing_statement.description: The agent's closing statement. If omitted, a default closing is generated.

response_wait_seconds.description: How long the agent waits for a learner response before prompting.

thinking_time_enabled.description: Whether the agent explicitly allows thinking time.

criteria.description: The competency criteria assessed by this rubric. Each is a discrete unit of competence.

description.description: Full description of what the criterion assesses and why it matters.

weight.description: Relative weight of this criterion in holistic judgement. Default equal weighting across criteria if omitted.

descriptors.description: Performance-level descriptors. Keys must match level identifiers declared in judgement_scheme.levels. At minimum, descriptors for the pass_threshold level and above must be provided.

opening_question.description: The primary question the agent asks to elicit evidence for this criterion.

probe_prompts.description: Authored follow-up questions the agent uses when responses are incomplete, unclear, or require deeper evidence. Probes are rubric-designer authored, not runtime-generated, to preserve pedagogical intent and consistency.

trigger.description: The condition under which this probe is used. Standard triggers listed; implementations may add custom triggers.

max_uses.description: Maximum times this specific probe can be used in a session.

evidence_indicators.description: Keywords, concepts, or phrases the agent listens for as evidence of competence. Used as hints for judgement, not strict matching. Can include synonyms and related terms.

non_revealing.description: If true, the agent must not reveal correct answers during the session. Default true for formative Socratic and all summative assessments.

xapi_verb.description: xAPI verb used when emitting learning records for this criterion. Allows interoperability with Learning Record Stores.

external_reference.description: Reference to a specific external standard's criterion or element. Framework-specific.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific or framework-specific extensions. Keys should be namespaced to avoid collisions.

session_constraints.description: Limits and guardrails for the assessment session.

max_probes_per_criterion.description: Maximum number of probe questions per criterion before moving on.

min_evidence_threshold.description: Minimum evidence sufficiency required before judgement can be made.

allow_topic_drift.description: Whether the agent allows the learner to explore related topics.

allow_learner_questions.description: Whether the learner may ask clarifying questions (formative only).

governance.description: Governance and ethical metadata. Fields marked required here are required for compliant AkoVoice deployments regardless of mode.

consent_required.description: Whether explicit informed consent must be captured before session start. Must be true for Observer and Moderator modes.

consent_statement.description: The consent statement presented to participants. Required when consent_required is true.

data_retention_days.description: Days session transcripts and evidence are retained before deletion. Zero means no retention (ephemeral).

data_jurisdiction.description: The legal jurisdiction governing data privacy and protection for session recordings and transcripts. Distinct from the qualification jurisdiction — a rubric may operate under NZ qualification rules but store data under EU GDPR if deployed by a European institution. Required when data_retention_days > 0. If omitted on ephemeral deployments (data_retention_days: 0), no data jurisdiction applies. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or regional code.

data_residency.description: Where session data must be stored. Supports national data sovereignty requirements.

data_sovereignty_notes.description: Indigenous data sovereignty, cultural protection, or other specific requirements beyond jurisdiction.

right_to_human_assessment.description: Whether learners retain the right to request human assessment as an alternative. Must be true for compliant AkoVoice deployments.

bias_audit_status.description: Status of bias audits performed on this rubric's deployment.

output_format.description: Configuration for session output and downstream integration.

xapi_enabled.description: Whether session results are emitted as xAPI statements.

xapi_endpoint.description: xAPI Learning Record Store endpoint for statement emission.

caliper_enabled.description: Whether session results are emitted as IMS Caliper events.

lti_grade_passback.description: Whether final judgement is passed back to the LMS gradebook via LTI AGS.

custom_webhook.description: Optional webhook URL for custom downstream integration.

metadata.description: Rubric authorship, licensing, and provenance metadata.

institution.description: Institution or organisation responsible for this rubric.

created.description: Date this rubric was originally created.

content_licence.description: Licence under which the rubric content is shared. Independent of the AkoVoice schema licence.

cultural_review.description: Record of cultural review and endorsement, where applicable.

pilot_status.description: Maturity of this rubric in real-world deployment.

extensions.description: Reserved for implementation-specific or community-defined extensions to the schema. Keys should be namespaced (e.g., 'org.example.custom_field') to avoid collisions. The AkoVoice schema itself will never define fields inside this block.
